title: Apple signs multibillion-dollar deal for Broadcom US-made components

sources.quote: Today Apple announced a new multiyear, multibillion-dollar agreement with Broadcom, a leading U.S. technology and advanced manufacturing company.

explain: Apple agreed to buy 5G radio parts and wireless chips designed and made by Broadcom in the US over several years. Apple called it 'multibillion-dollar' but gave no exact number.
